sections.title: My Recommendation

blocks.text: The next entity should be Integration Connector.
API Endpoints and Webhooks provide the communication mechanism.
An Integration Connector provides the business-specific integration package.

Each connector bundles API endpoints, webhooks, authentication, mappings, synchronization rules, and error handling into a reusable integration that organizations can enable or disable with minimal configuration. That moves KoreVity from offering low-level integration primitives to delivering enterprise-ready integrations.
Now we move from integration infrastructure to business integrations.
This is one of the biggest differences between a platform and an ecosystem.

An API Rate Limit entity provides configurable quotas, throttling, burst limits, and enforcement policies per API Client or Endpoint, ensuring the platform remains secure, fair, and performant under heavy load.
Up until now we've built a system that can scale.

This is one of the most important platform security services.
